# Shared test cases for the sound event detector.
#
# The Android app (EventDetector.kt) and the Raspberry Pi monitor (detector.py) must
# both produce exactly these events, so the two implementations cannot drift apart.
#
#   case    name of the case
#   config  optional overrides, as key=value pairs using the Python field names
#   frames  levels in dBFS as LEVELxCOUNT; every frame is 50 ms and time starts at 0
#   expect  one line per expected event: start_ms duration_ms peak_db
#
# The detector is flushed after the last frame.

case single short bark
frames -70x40 -20x4 -70x60
expect 2000 200 -20

case one loud frame is too short to count
frames -70x40 -20x1 -70x60

case barks close together are one event
frames -70x40 -20x4 -70x20 -15x4 -70x60
expect 2000 1400 -15

case barks far apart are separate events
frames -70x40 -20x4 -70x50 -15x4 -70x60
expect 2000 200 -20
expect 4700 200 -15

case sounds under the minimum level are ignored
frames -70x40 -55x10 -70x40

case a noisy room raises the threshold
frames -40x400 -30x10 -40x20 -15x4 -40x60
expect 21500 200 -15

case long noise is split into several events
config max_event_ms=1000 hold_ms=200
frames -70x20 -20x50 -70x20
expect 1000 1000 -20
expect 2000 1000 -20
expect 3000 500 -20

case stopping ends the event in progress
frames -70x20 -20x10
expect 1000 500 -20

case high sensitivity catches a sound just above the room
config margin_db=8
frames -45x200 -35x4 -45x60
expect 10000 200 -35

case default sensitivity ignores that same sound
frames -45x200 -35x4 -45x60
